Sign convention (simplicial-only) validated by d^2=0; rank results are invariant under diagonal +/-1 rescaling. This is a finite exact linear-algebra certificate, i.e. proof at E2 level, not heuristic evidence. No Moss/Toda/indeterminacy claim is made, matching the stated E2-only limitation.
